title: You Have Won!
intro: A text just arrived. You have won a big prize, it says. You never entered anything.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

screen.context: You have not entered any contest.

msg: To receive it, first pay a

msg.text: You were picked from all mobile numbers.

noentry.label: No contest entered
noentry.lens: You never entered a draw. You were "picked from all numbers".
noentry.why: Winning something you never entered is a warning sign.

prize.label: A huge prize
prize.why: A big prize out of nowhere is the bait.

tax.label: Pay to collect
tax.lens: You must pay $100 "tax" before the prize arrives.
tax.why: Real prizes are free to collect. A fee is the scam.

link.label: Look-alike link
link.lens: The link goes to luckyvale-prizeclaim.example, a page made only to take your card details.
link.why: Never pay through a link in a text. Search the name yourself instead.

timer.label: Countdown pressure
timer.why: Rushing you is a pressure trick. A real prize does not expire in minutes.

sender.label: A friendly name
sender.lens: The sender is called Luckyvale Draw.
sender.why: Anyone can type a name into a text. It proves nothing.

time.label: Sent at 11:05 AM
time.why: Scam texts come at any hour. The time proves nothing.

actions.label: Open the link and pay the tax
Search the draw's name for warnings

trap.title: Luckyvale Draw · Claim
trap.ask: Pay $100 to release your prize. Enter your card number.

block_report.line: Reported and deleted. Your phone company can now block more of these texts.

verify.line: No draw, no prize, and the name only appeared on scam warnings. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: The "tax" page copied your card details. The prize never came, and bigger payments followed.

what_if.go_ahead: A real prize never costs money to collect. Not having entered at all was the first clue.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: If you must pay to collect a prize, it is not a prize. Delete it.

quick_check.q: A text says you won a big prize but must pay a "tax" first. You never entered. What do you do?

options.text: Pay the tax, the prize is much bigger
Do not pay. Delete it and report the text
Send half now and half later

quick_check.explain: Real prizes are free. A fee to claim is the scam.

hints.nudge: Did you ever enter this draw?

rows.v: A mobile number you do not know
No. A fee to collect a prize is a scam

rows.k: A prize for a contest you never entered
